verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developer.intuit.com that returns HTTP 200 and is structured for agents, with one section per product. It includes a QuickBooks Workforce API section covering payroll development, webhooks, and workflows such as employees, deductions, and payslips. Missing for 10: a payroll-specific agent doc (the llms.txt is shared across all Intuit developer products), any independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
